name: Ancascocha trek to Machu Picchu
why: The quiet way to Machu Picchu: past the Perolniyoc waterfall and Inca ruins, over high passes of about 4,650 m by the Ancascocha lake, then down into the Inca Trail valley.
book: Through a Cusco agency (cook, mules, train back from Aguas Calientes). The last day may join the classic Inca Trail, which needs its own permit.
dangers: Cold nights below zero from June to August.

points.name: Perolniyoc waterfall
points.note: A waterfall in a narrow valley below an Inca fort.

points.name: Ancascocha
points.note: A high lake and herders' hamlet under snow peaks.

points.name: Paucarcancha
points.note: Inca ruins where the trail meets the Inca Trail valley.
